pages.text: A 3x3x3 cube of $(item)casings$(), $(item)reactor glass$() allowed in the middle of each side, the centre empty. The controller in the middle of the front. $(thing)Right-click the controller$() to assemble, then to open it.

Burns $(item)nuclear micro reactors$(): $(thing)3000 FE/t$(), each gives three times the energy it gives in the small generator. It heats up and needs $(thing)water$() (10 mB/t, bucket or pipe). At 1000 heat it shuts down until cooled to half. Radiation around it while running.
pages.title: Operation
